# Cefrly

> CEFR (English proficiency) mock exams and preparation for Uzbek learners.
> Timed Reading and Listening papers graded to an indicative CEFR band
> (below B1 / B1 / B2 / C1), plus model Writing and Speaking answers.

Cefrly is a single-page web app. Almost everything below the marketing pages
requires an account, so only the public pages are listed here.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cefrly.vercel.app/): personal dashboard; signed-out visitors are sent to log in.
- [Log in](https://cefrly.vercel.app/login): email or Google sign-in.
- [Sign up](https://cefrly.vercel.app/signup): create an account.
- [Pricing](https://cefrly.vercel.app/pricing): Free, Pro and Premium plans.
- [Support](https://cefrly.vercel.app/support): FAQ and the Telegram community.

## Optional

- [Robots](https://cefrly.vercel.app/robots.txt): crawl rules.
- [Sitemap](https://cefrly.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): the publicly indexable pages.
